TRAYAKSH ARCHITEQTS is a multidisciplinary design practice working across architecture, interior design and project management, with a growing portfolio of residential, commercial and retail projects.

Mumbai & Ratnagiri · Working across India

We believe good design should not compete with life. It should quietly make life better.

WHY TRAYAKSH

Thoughtful design.
Practical thinking.
Our perspective
↗
01
Design with purpose

We look beyond aesthetics to understand how every space needs to function.

02
Three-eyed thinking

Space, People and Possibility form the foundation of our design process.

03
Nature as a design element

Natural light, ventilation, landscape and materiality are considered as integral components of the design.

04
Minimal, not ordinary

Our restrained aesthetic is intended to create clarity, comfort and longevity—not simply an absence of elements.

05
Design + project management

Our background combines creative design thinking with an understanding of planning and execution.

06
Personal, not predefined

We do not impose a signature style on every project. The design language evolves from the client, context and purpose.
